ending: Alex remains at the University of Generasi with Selina, Theresa, and Brutus. His identity as the Fool and his contact with the dungeon core remain hidden from priests and almost everyone at the university. He keeps core sand and the Traveler's book as clues, while his work with Professor Jules and his application to a golem workshop offer ways to investigate further. He can now cast Forceball, Force Disc, and Wizard's Hand, and meditation helps him manage the mark's disruption. Theresa is progressing in life-force cultivation, supports Alex's training, and shares a growing but still undeclared romantic bond with him. Selina's strong fire affinity opens a path into magic but leaves her confronting trauma tied to her parents' deaths. Khalik, Isolde, and Thundar remain allies, and Alex alone among the group knows Khalik is a prince. Minervus remains a rival for the workshop position, while Carey's effort to expand Uldar worship could bring priests closer to Alex. Beyond the city wards, a core hunter has located Generasi and plans to return with its siblings and controlled beasts to create an opening for a stealth attack.
in_short: On his eighteenth birthday, aspiring wizard Alex Roth receives the Fool's mark, which obstructs combat, divinity, and spellcraft while accelerating other kinds of learning. He flees Tameland with his sister Selina, his friend Theresa Lu, and her Cerberus, Brutus. They cross an active portal dungeon, where Alex briefly controls a weakened core before the Traveler's magic destroys it. At Generasi, Alex conceals his identity and turns the mark's interference into a demanding program of magical, physical, and mental training. He builds friendships with Khalik, Isolde, and Thundar, studies under Baelin and several professors, and pursues golemcraft as a path toward understanding the core. Theresa advances in life-force cultivation and teaches him meditation. Selina proves to have exceptional fire affinity, which triggers her trauma over their parents' deaths. As Alex competes for a golem-workshop post, a core hunter traces its quarry to Generasi and withdraws to gather allies for an attack.

recaps.text:
On his eighteenth birthday, Alex Roth inherits his family's money and prepares to leave Ulrich with his younger sister, Selina, so he can study magic at Generasi. The return of an ancient recurring enemy changes those plans. Five marked heroes are called to oppose its dungeons, and Alex discovers that he bears the Fool's mark. The mark floods him with memories of failure when he attempts combat, divinity, or spellcraft, but helps him learn other skills rapidly. Alex proves that magic is difficult rather than impossible for him, then decides to escape before Uldar's priests can force him into hero duty.

Theresa Lu discovers his secret and joins him with her three-headed Cerberus, Brutus. The four leave Ulrich and survive an attack by a silent spider creature from a nearby dungeon. Cedric, the Chosen, heals Brutus and explains that a holy detection ring blocks marked people from leaving by sea. Alex therefore chooses the dangerous Cave of the Traveler as an alternate route. After promising not to abandon Selina, he tells her about the mark. Theresa prepares a scent-masking mixture, and the entire group enters the active portal dungeon together.

Inside the Cave of the Traveler, Alex's party finds an ancient temple overrun by dungeon spiders. Alex maps trapped floor tiles and redirects the temple's tracking fire against the swarm. The group discovers unstable portal crossroads, retrieves powerful fire gems, and reaches a vast sanctum where stable portals surround the Traveler's mummified body. A hive queen carrying the dungeon core attacks before they can use the portal to the Rhinian Empire.

Alex overloads a fire gem, and Theresa throws it through a portal to a lava field. The resulting eruption cripples the queen, which Theresa finishes. Alex then links himself to the weakened core and learns to control it long enough to create a step beside their escape portal. The Traveler's blue magic destroys the exposed core. Alex takes some core sand and an iron-bound book, convinced that known history hides the Fool's ability to influence cores. The group reaches Port Mausar by way of the Rhinian Empire. Later, Cedric's party finds the ruined dungeon and mistakenly credits the Traveler with destroying the core. The recurring enemy responds by dispatching five specialized hunters to kill the unknown core usurper.

Alex, Theresa, Selina, and Brutus book passage to Generasi aboard the Red Siren. Its captain, Fan-Dor, offers Alex lessons in the crew's Spear and Oar Dance. Alex discovers that the mark permits the dance's movement when he practices with a mop, giving him a possible method of evasion that avoids direct combat. Tests with Theresa's weapons further suggest that the mark interferes most strongly with deliberate attacks and objects meant solely for fighting.

A suspicious passenger magically puts the night watch to sleep and reveals itself as a mana vampire. Alone on deck, Alex uses Forceball as an obstacle, the mop dance to retreat, and spilled water to make the creature fall. When it leaps at him, he braces the mop and lets its own momentum cause the injury. Fan-Dor and his first mate arrive and kill it. Alex shares the bounty with them, strengthening their friendship and increasing his funds. The Red Siren reaches Generasi, but priests of Uldar are collecting donations at the gate. Alex guides his companions away before anyone can inspect his concealed mark.

Alex's household reaches the University of Generasi, where registrar Hobb arranges Alex's enrollment, an apartment, Theresa's status as an auditor, and a junior-school place for Selina. Their savings can support them for about two years, so Alex begins looking for income as well as answers about the dungeon core. The library's useful material is restricted by spell tier, and advanced potion-analysis equipment is unavailable to an unproven first-year.

Alex chooses courses in magic lore, potions, mana manipulation, force spells, and combat survival. Baelin, the university chancellor, teaches COMB 1000 and encourages practical adaptation. Alex systematically studies the mark's spellcasting failures, improves Forceball, and learns that controlled practice can turn some failed patterns into useful changes. He befriends his neighbor Khalik and Khalik's eagle familiar, Najyah. Isolde exposes Derek's academic cheating, while Professor Jules makes him repeat introductory potions. Alex and Khalik train together before COMB 1000, and Alex experiments with moving and manipulating terrain through Forceball. After dozens of failed attempts, he finally learns a second spell, Force Disc, just before Baelin's course begins.

Theresa begins life-force cultivation under Kabbot-Xin, passes the affinity test, and starts the difficult work of opening her channels. Meanwhile, Baelin sends COMB 1000 candidates into the Barrens in groups of four. Alex is assigned to Khalik, the lightning caster Isolde, and the minotaur Thundar. They combine scouting, protective magic, physical strength, and Alex's indirect use of Forceball to cross monster territory under a strict time limit.

The group survives two attacks by furred humanoid creatures, then encounters a Bonedrinker near the final escarpment. Isolde's lightning knocks the armored predator down but does not finish it. The team and another student target its vulnerable eyes and mouth while Alex distracts it. His Forceball enters its wounded mouth and sends it falling to the pursuing monsters below. Twelve of twenty candidates pass. Baelin praises Alex's team for balancing its abilities and admits the survivors to the course. He also tells Alex that his ban on priests reflects his belief that gods exploit mortals and that cultivation offers another path to divinity. Alex's friends and household celebrate both the field-test success and Theresa's progress.

Alex begins formal potion and mana-manipulation classes while guarding his secrets. Carey London, a student from Tameland and a devotee of Uldar, asks about research into the recurring dungeons. Professor Jules explains that living cores disintegrate when taken too far from Tameland, leaving the mystery unsolved. Carey's effort to organize worship and bring priests closer to campus makes her useful as a possible research contact but dangerous to Alex.

At a city workshop, Alex senses that a raw golem core carries mana faintly similar to the dungeon core. An upcoming assistant vacancy offers both income and access, so he resolves to acquire the required skills. The mark lets him advance through mana-manipulation exercises at exceptional speed and maintain Force Disc while working on a glyph box. Theresa's cultivation improves her health and stamina, and she realizes meditation may teach Alex to acknowledge the mark's intrusive memories without following them. Her lessons make his casting smoother and strengthen his awareness. Alex also accepts that his feelings for Theresa are romantic. Professor Jules verifies that his unusual ability is genuine and suggests that continued excellence could earn him access to a personal project.

Baelin assigns COMB 1000 to capture ten vent drinkers alive in terrain that disrupts spellcasters. Nua-Oge proposes using companions with little mana to drive the creatures into a broad net. Minervus rejects cooperation and leaves with his attendants, while Rain joins the main group. Theresa, Grimlock, and other physical fighters act as chasers, and Alex maintains two Force Discs as nonlethal traps. The cooperating group captures ten creatures before a larger predator arrives. Minervus manages only one, and Baelin removes him from the course after revealing that his five attendants are flesh golems whose connection failed near the vents.

Alex continues excelling in mana manipulation and safely completes his first potion lab. When another student drinks an unfinished quicksilver mixture, Alex's command of the emergency procedures helps Professor Jules stabilize the victim. Val'Rok offers Alex a chance to challenge the mana course for credit and earn a workshop reference. Jules will not waive the full potions course, but she recruits Alex as a temporary assistant on a graduate project and may also recommend him. Professor Ram begins teaching Alex that force magic is powerful but never invulnerable.

Alex joins Professor Jules's graduate laboratory team as a support assistant. The group summons a shape-changing otherworldly servitor, contains it, and bargains for part of its chaos essence in exchange for food and release. Jules warns that the extracted substance is dangerously unstable, but explains that a carefully diluted dose can let a golem evolve. The later stages of the project also overlap with golem-core construction, making the work directly relevant to Alex's goals.

The encounter leaves Alex badly shaken. When he seeks ordinary help from Hobb, the registrar reveals that he is a devil bound to university service by an old contract and forbidden to make new deals with mortals. Khalik helps Alex understand that supernatural fear can alter the mind and encourages him to prepare through knowledge rather than remain overwhelmed. Khalik then entrusts Alex with a secret of his own: he is Khalik Bermeder, the second prince of Tekizash. Alex promises confidentiality but does not disclose the Fool's mark in return. He resumes his physical, magical, alchemical, and dance training with renewed determination.

After months of disciplined exercise, diet, and meditation, Alex is stronger and more enduring. Val'Rok teaches him an advanced mana-regeneration method, and Alex combines it with meditation until he can nearly double his daily magical work. A golem workshop opens applications for three paid assistant positions. Minervus applies and claims his family background makes him the better candidate, but Alex remains committed because the job would provide income, experience with golem cores, and a route toward building a golem of his own.

Alex and Selina become collaborators in sculpting, with each improving through the other's strengths. He also gives permission for her junior school to test her magical potential. After sustained analysis of many failures, Alex finally casts Wizard's Hand and begins looking for ways to simplify its circuit. At Selina's test, summoned sprites identify her as possessing exceptionally strong fire affinity. The flames immediately revive the trauma connected to the fire that killed the Roth parents. Selina screams in terror, leaving her promising magical future inseparable from grief and fear that have not yet been resolved.

Alex, Selina, Theresa, and Brutus remain established at Generasi. Alex has transformed the Fool's mark from a simple disability into the center of a broad training method, learning Forceball, Force Disc, Wizard's Hand, advanced mana control, and meditation while keeping his identity secret. His work with Professor Jules and his application for the golem-workshop position may help him investigate the destroyed core and the hidden history of the Fool. Theresa continues life-force cultivation and remains his closest partner, while Selina must now reconcile her powerful fire affinity with the trauma of their parents' deaths. Khalik, Isolde, and Thundar remain allies, and Khalik's royal identity is known only to Alex among their circle.

Outside Generasi, one of the core hunters follows its magical tracking signal across sea and land. It learns to mimic sounds and voices, reaches the warded city, and determines that a direct infiltration would be too dangerous. It withdraws to find its siblings and recruit or dominate local beasts. Its plan is to return with enough forces to distract Generasi's defenders and create an opening for a concealed attack on its quarry.
